title: SightLine Risk Assessment Stream Event
description: Envelope for a single push over the live update channel (WebSocket/SSE) from backend to dashboard. Wraps risk_assessment_schema.json - the frontend never receives a bare assessment object over the stream, only this envelope, so it always knows whether something is new or a re-score of an existing transaction, and can order/dedupe events via `sequence`.

event_type.description: CREATED: a new transaction was scored for the first time. UPDATED: an existing transaction's risk/typology_signals changed (e.g. a later transaction pushed it into a structuring window). REVIEW_STATUS_CHANGED: only governance.review_status/reviewed_by changed - lets the frontend patch just that field instead of re-rendering the whole row.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing per backend instance. Frontend uses this to detect gaps/dropped events on reconnect (request replay from last-seen sequence) and to ignore out-of-order duplicates, not for cross-instance ordering.

assessment.description: Full assessment object. Always sent in full (not a diff) - simplest correct behavior for a dashboard rebuilding row state from streamed events; revisit only if payload size becomes an actual bottleneck.
